description: Load one Edgegap agent skill: its SKILL.md (the workflow to follow) by default, or one of its reference documents or templates with file. Load the matching skill before acting on a game project — edgegap-fishnet for Unity with FishNet, edgegap-purrnet for Unity with PurrNet, edgegap-unity for other Unity projects, edgegap-unreal for Unreal Engine, edgegap-manus for a browser game built with Manus, edgegap otherwise — and fetch the references and templates it points to as you reach them. No API call.

file.description: A file inside the skill, e.g. "references/deploy.md" or "assets/docker/Dockerfile". Default SKILL.md.

skill.description: Skill name, from edgegap_list_skills: edgegap, edgegap-containerize, edgegap-deployments-api, edgegap-fishnet, edgegap-launch, edgegap-local-testing, edgegap-manus, edgegap-purrnet, edgegap-server-design, edgegap-troubleshoot, edgegap-unity, edgegap-unreal.

name: edgegap_get_skill
title: Load an Edgegap agent skill
